title: restiaria dasyphylla
intro: Restiaria dasyphylla, commonly known as Chinese Restharrow, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Restiaria dasyphylla include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, and treating infections. The bioactive constituents of Restiaria dasyphylla include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
